concepts: recipient reach pause or restrained amusement

concept_terms: recipient reach pause or restrained amusement

paraphrases: 성인 인물이 회전이나 걸음을 천천히 이어가는 중간 단계에서 지지 발과 도착 방향, 뒤따르는 직물의 지연이 함께 보이는 장면
an adult pauses mid-turn with one planted support path, an unfinished destination, and fabric lag showing deliberate low tempo
alert eyes and a controlled hand trajectory keep the slow movement distinct from fatigue or intoxication
positive_fields.definition: An unmistakably adult subject is captured in one deliberate low-tempo transition whose start and destination remain spatially readable, while stable support, alert task-linked attention, and coherent fabric, hair, hand, or object lag distinguish controlled pacing from sleep, intoxication, illness, collapse, or a settled static pose; the movement is not sexual by default.

paraphrases: 성인 인물이 행사가 끝난 낡은 호화 호텔에서 꺼진 촛농과 눌린 벨벳, 넘어진 잔을 정리하며 천천히 다음 행동으로 옮겨가는 장면
an alert adult crosses a faded hotel salon after an event, touching worn velvet while wax and displaced objects show excess and aftermath
former luxury, physical decay, after-event residue, and one controlled unfinished action coexist
positive_fields.definition: An unmistakably adult subject remains alert and self-directed inside an environment that visibly carries both former luxury and material after-event decline, with an unfinished slow action linking the adult to the residue; dark color, red light, gothic styling, or a reclining pose alone does not establish decadence or sensuality.

paraphrases: 정면에서 얼굴 세로가 폭보다 적당히 길고 광대 부근이 살짝 가장 넓으며 턱끝으로 부드럽게 좁아지는 얼굴
a moderately elongated face whose widest cheek region flows smoothly toward a narrower rounded chin
an egg-like full facial contour without a broad jaw corner or a sharply pointed lower face
positive_fields.definition: A complete face perimeter that is moderately longer than wide, with the lateral zygomatic region subtly widest, a smooth transition toward a somewhat narrower forehead and jaw, and a continuous soft taper into a narrow rounded chin.

paraphrases: 얼굴 세로와 가로가 비슷하고 볼 부근이 넓게 이어지며 턱선이 짧고 둥근 얼굴
a compact face with near-equal length and width and no abrupt angular jaw corner
broad cheek width continuing through a curved lower contour into a short rounded chin
positive_fields.definition: A complete compact face perimeter whose vertical length stays close to its transverse width, with broad cheek-to-cheek presence and a continuously curved jaw that ends in a short rounded chin.

paraphrases: 이마·광대·턱 폭이 크게 벌어지지 않은 채 얼굴 세로가 뚜렷이 긴 얼굴
an elongated face with relatively parallel side widths and a softly ended lower contour
more vertical extension than an oval face without the broad jaw corners of a rectangle
positive_fields.definition: A complete face perimeter visibly longer than wide, with forehead, zygomatic, and bigonial widths remaining comparatively parallel and an elongated lower contour that ends softly rather than in a broad angular jaw.

paraphrases: 얼굴 길이와 폭이 비슷하고 이마·광대·하악 폭이 크게 좁아지지 않으며 턱 모서리가 넓고 각진 얼굴
a near-equal length-width face with relatively straight sides and broad jaw corners
a broad chin and gonial region completing the same square perimeter
positive_fields.definition: A complete face perimeter with length close to width, relatively comparable forehead, zygomatic, and bigonial breadths, and broad readable jaw corners continuing into a broad chin.

paraphrases: 사각형 얼굴의 넓고 각진 턱과 비교적 평행한 옆선을 유지하면서 세로가 더 긴 얼굴
an elongated face with broad jaw corners rather than a softly narrowed oblong lower end
parallel upper-to-lower widths and a broad chin surviving the greater vertical span
positive_fields.definition: A complete face perimeter clearly longer than wide while forehead, zygomatic, and bigonial breadths remain comparatively parallel, with broad angular jaw corners and a broad chin preserving the square-like lower structure through the elongation.

paraphrases: 이마와 관자 폭보다 아래 볼과 하악 폭이 넓어 아래 얼굴이 지배적으로 보이는 얼굴
a face that widens from the upper temples toward broad jaw corners
lower-face breadth owns the triangle rather than one large chin or full cheek
positive_fields.definition: A complete face perimeter whose forehead and temples are narrower than the lower cheek and bigonial region, creating an outward upper-to-lower transition toward a broad jaw before the chin.

paraphrases: 광대 폭이 가장 넓고 이마·관자와 하악·턱끝으로 양쪽 방향에서 좁아지는 얼굴
a face widest at the lateral zygomatic region and narrower above and below
high cheekbone projection does not count unless lateral width owns the full diamond perimeter
positive_fields.definition: A complete face perimeter whose lateral zygomatic region is clearly widest, with two-direction narrowing toward both the forehead-temple region and the jaw-chin region, ending in a small chin.

paraphrases: 넓은 이마와 상부 얼굴에서 하악 폭이 줄고 좁은 턱끝으로 계속 좁아지는 얼굴
a wider forehead tapering continuously through the lower face toward a narrow chin
heart and inverted-triangle labels overlap in the upper-to-lower width relation while the hairline cue remains optional
positive_fields.definition: A complete upper-face-dominant perimeter in which forehead and upper-temple breadth exceed jaw width and the contour narrows continuously through the lower cheeks toward a narrow chin; a central widow's peak may support the heart variant but is optional.

paraphrases: 광대 아래에서 하악 폭이 분명히 줄고 좁은 턱끝까지 연속적으로 모이는 하안면
a coherent cheek-to-jaw-to-chin narrowing across the entire lower face
a pointed chin is insufficient unless both jaw sides participate in the taper
positive_fields.definition: A complete facial perimeter in which the lower face narrows coherently from the cheek region through distinctly reduced bigonial width into a compact narrow chin, producing a readable V-like lower contour rather than an isolated pointed tip.
concepts: cheek region as upper lower-face reference

concept_terms: cheek region as upper lower-face reference

paraphrases: 광대 아래에서도 하악 폭이 어느 정도 유지되다가 넓고 둥근 호로 턱끝에 연결되는 하안면
a lower jaw that stays laterally broad before rounding into the chin
whole-face roundness is not required when the U-shaped relation belongs specifically to the lower contour
positive_fields.definition: A complete facial perimeter whose lower jaw retains appreciable lateral width below the cheeks before turning through a broad rounded mandibular arc into the chin, creating a U-like lower contour without requiring the whole face to be round.

paraphrases: 상·중안면은 길이가 적당한 타원형이고 광대 아래에서 턱끝까지 더 강하게 매끄럽게 좁아지는 씨앗형 얼굴
a moderately elongated oval upper-mid face with stronger lower-face taper than an egg-shaped oval
a small softly pointed or rounded chin completes the smooth lower taper without becoming a surgery or beauty-value claim
positive_fields.definition: A culture-scoped composite in which a moderately elongated oval upper and middle facial perimeter reaches its wider region around the cheeks, then narrows more strongly and smoothly through the jaw into a small rounded or softly pointed chin; no fixed ratio, ethnicity, attractiveness, or personality is implied.
concepts: small rounded or softly pointed chin

concept_terms: small rounded or softly pointed chin

paraphrases: 얇은 톤 보정 아래 실제 피부 변화가 남고 눈썹 속눈썹 볼 입술은 절제된 메이크업
cosmetics are present but each layer remains low contrast and subordinate to readable skin
targeted correction and grooming without turning the face into bare skin or full glam
positive_fields.definition: A deliberately applied cosmetic look with sheer or localized complexion correction, retained pores and natural color variation, restrained brow lash cheek and lip definition, and no single high-contrast region dominating the face.

paraphrases: 속눈썹선이 가장 짙고 눈꺼풀과 크리즈 위로 갈수록 부드럽게 옅어지는 아이섀도
dark pigment begins at the lash roots and loses density smoothly upward and outward
optional lower-lid support remains connected to the eye design rather than resembling a bruise
positive_fields.definition: An eyeshadow structure whose darkest cosmetic density is anchored at the upper lash line and often the outer lid, then diffuses through a continuous decreasing gradient across the mobile lid and crease without becoming a hard rectangular block.

paraphrases: 움직이는 눈꺼풀의 밝은 면과 크리즈 위 짙은 색이 깨끗한 경계로 나뉜 아이섀도
a cleaned mobile lid remains distinct from the deeper transition shade above the crease
the crease edge is a cosmetic boundary rather than the natural fold shadow itself
positive_fields.definition: An eyeshadow construction with a deliberate clean boundary near the crease that separates a lighter or distinct mobile-lid plane from deeper color above it, maintaining contrast and a continuous designed edge across the visible lid.

paraphrases: 속눈썹선과 떨어진 그래픽 라인 사이에 깨끗한 피부 여백이 남는 아이라이너
a precise floating stroke has coherent endpoints and a readable unpainted gap beneath it
negative space belongs to the line geometry rather than an accidental missing segment
positive_fields.definition: A deliberate eyeliner stroke or closed graphic segment positioned partly away from the natural lash line so that a clean band of unpainted skin remains visibly bounded between the cosmetic line and the eye or lid structure.

paraphrases: 얼굴 전반의 부드러운 광과 높은 면의 제한된 반사광이 함께 보이면서 모공은 남는 피부 표현
diffuse radiance spans the complexion while sharper highlights stay localized to coherent facial planes
luminous cosmetics remain distinct from greasy hotspots and a poreless smoothing filter
positive_fields.definition: A complexion finish combining broad low-contrast diffuse radiance with controlled face-plane-following specular highlights while pores and natural microtexture remain visible, so luminosity reads as a cosmetic optical layer rather than oil, plastic retouching, or overexposure.

paraphrases: 윗입술과 아랫입술 안쪽이 가장 진하고 바깥 경계로 갈수록 한 색이 연속적으로 옅어지는 립
one cosmetic hue fades from a saturated inner center to a softer outer lip boundary
matte satin or gloss may vary without replacing the required center-to-edge color gradient
positive_fields.definition: A one-color lip pigment distribution with the highest saturation at the inner center of both lips, a continuous decrease toward the outer vermilion, and a deliberately softened final edge while lip anatomy and surface finish remain separately readable.

paraphrases: 양쪽 높은 볼의 따뜻한 블러셔가 콧등을 지나 하나의 부드러운 가로 분포로 이어지는 화장
warm blush remains bilaterally coordinated across high cheeks and nose rather than isolated red spots
the cross-face pigment is cosmetic and must not resemble peeling painful or inflamed skin
positive_fields.definition: A warm cosmetic pigment distribution spanning both high cheeks and crossing the nose bridge as one coordinated band with soft controlled edges, explicitly separated from actual ultraviolet injury, inflammation, fever, white-balance shifts, and colored illumination.

paraphrases: 얼굴의 들어간 면에는 국소적인 매트 음영 색을, 높은 면에는 밝은 제품을 배치하고 경계를 블렌딩한 메이크업
dark cosmetic placement and light cosmetic placement occupy opposing but coherent facial planes
one consistent illumination field proves that the dimension comes from product placement rather than moving shadows
positive_fields.definition: A cosmetic plane treatment combining localized matte darker pigment on selected receding facial regions with localized lighter or reflective product on selected high planes, joined by blended transitions and remaining distinguishable from anatomy, global dodge-and-burn, and cast lighting.

paraphrases: 윗부분은 길게 남고 옆과 뒤는 짧으며 두 길이 영역 사이의 단절선이 보이는 헤어컷
the top mass remains longer while the sides and nape form a separate short block
weight and volume change abruptly at the boundary between the upper and lower sections
positive_fields.definition: A disconnected haircut containing a visibly longer upper section and distinctly shorter side and back sections, separated by an abrupt readable boundary rather than a continuously blended fade.

paraphrases: 긴 뒷머리 위에 좌우 얼굴 옆의 뭉툭한 짧은 패널과 길이 단차가 보이는 스타일
paired cheek-to-jaw side panels end bluntly in front of a longer rear mass
a full fringe may support the look but cannot replace the paired side panels and disconnection
positive_fields.definition: A long-hair cut structure with a retained rear length and paired blunt face-side panels ending around the cheek or jaw, joined by a clearly readable disconnected length step rather than ordinary blended framing layers.

paraphrases: 두피에 밀착되어 경로를 따라 이어지는 여러 개의 좁은 브레이드와 가르마 통로
many narrow braided ridges remain anchored to the scalp along repeated row paths
the row layout may be straight or patterned while scalp attachment and parting lanes remain invariant
positive_fields.definition: A scalp-braided topology made of multiple narrow continuous braided rows attached closely along the scalp, separated by readable parting lanes and remaining distinct from large raised braids or free-hanging individual braids.

paraphrases: 뿌리 부근부터 끝까지 이어지는 여러 개의 지속적인 코드형 잠김 다발
many rope-like hair cords remain individually continuous without repeating three-strand crossings
cord diameter and length may vary while persistent locked continuity remains visible
positive_fields.definition: A hairstyle composed of multiple persistent cordlike locked sections that remain continuous from near the roots toward the ends, without the periodic strand crossings of braids and without the temporary adhesion pattern of wet clumps.

paraphrases: 좌우 두피의 묶임점 두 개에서 각각 별도 머리 다발이 이어지는 양갈래 배열
two independently gathered bundles descend from two bilateral attachment points
height length and curl may vary while two tie points and two trailing bundles remain invariant
positive_fields.definition: A bilateral gathered hairstyle with two visible left and right scalp tie points, each feeding a separately trailing hair bundle, while root-to-tie continuity distinguishes the arrangement from loose side locks or face-framing strands.

paraphrases: 어두운 뿌리에서 부드럽게 이어지며 중간과 끝에 불규칙한 밝은 리본이 분산된 염색
lighter ribbons appear at varied positions and widths across the hair surface
the base color remains visible between ribbons instead of becoming one continuous ombre field
positive_fields.definition: A distributed hair-color placement built from irregular freehand lighter ribbons through the mid-lengths and ends, retaining a darker base and soft root transitions rather than forming one full-width root-to-end gradient.

paraphrases: 마른 머리보다 부피가 줄고 여러 가닥이 젖은 다발로 뭉쳐 얼굴이나 목에 일부 붙은 상태
moist strands group into weighted bundles and lose airy separation
shine may support the state but clumping volume collapse and local adhesion establish it
positive_fields.definition: A visibly wet or damp temporary hair state combining reduced dry-hair volume, strand bundling and clumping, directional weight or local adherence, and coherent moisture evidence rather than relying on specular shine or sleek styling alone.

paraphrases: 피부 결이 남는 얇은 새틴 베이스 위에 눈썹 눈 볼 입술의 대비가 서로 절제된 정돈형 내추럴 메이크업
a polished cosmetic layer remains visibly applied while no eye cheek or lip region overpowers the complexion
neutral taupe eye definition muted rose cheeks and a softly centered rosy-coral lip coexist under a texture-preserving complexion
positive_fields.definition: A coherent applied makeup system whose readable sheer-to-light satin complexion leads the hierarchy while low-contrast brow, neutral eye, muted cheek, and centered soft lip treatments remain individually visible and mutually restrained.

paraphrases: 살아 있는 술자가 특정 망자의 유품을 통해 질문하고 그 망자만의 응답을 받는 장면
a living practitioner questions one identified dead person through a memorial anchor and the scene visibly changes in reply
one inert fictional body changes into a commanded state only after the operator's deliberate act
positive_fields.definition: A living operator deliberately establishes a causal relation to one specific dead person or their remains and receives a localized answer, manifestation, release, binding result, or commanded bodily response. Historical consultation and modern-fantasy reanimation are separate scene variants inside the same operator-to-dead causal contract.

paraphrases: 생전 초상과 같은 인물이 현실에는 없고 거울에만 나타나 이전 습관을 반복한다
a former person appears only in a reflection while a memorial object confirms who they were
an identifiable dead person crosses one closed threshold and leaves one localized consequence
positive_fields.definition: A disembodied presence continuous with one formerly living person, made legible by a former-identity anchor plus one coherent impossible presence or agency relation. Translucency, blur, fog, or double exposure alone is a capture convention rather than proof of a ghost.

paraphrases: 저승사자가 한 망자와 나란히 걸으며 문턱을 열어 다음 영역으로 인도한다
a Korean afterlife guide checks a closed destination ledger and personally escorts one deceased traveler
the handoff becomes visible at a gate river crossing or transit threshold
positive_fields.definition: A Korean afterlife mediator whose role is visible through a deceased traveler, an escort or handoff action, and a passage boundary. Popular dark clothing or a gat may support a variant but cannot replace the guide-to-traveler relationship, and the role is not automatically the Western skeletal personification of Death.

paraphrases: 해골 형상의 죽음이 마지막 모래시계를 뒤집자 시계의 최종 숫자가 꺼진다
an embodied Death figure performs the terminal action while vanitas objects reinforce rather than replace it
the mortal witness and affected clock make the personification an active agent
positive_fields.definition: An anthropomorphic Western Death agent performing a mortality or terminal-transition action on a visible target. Skeleton, scythe, hourglass, wilted flowers, or extinguished flame are supporting iconography; at least the embodied agent, decisive action, and affected target or state change must be visible.

paraphrases: 불투명한 깨끗한 시신보 아래 인체 윤곽이 운반대에 완전히 지지되고 기록 담당자가 존엄하게 이송을 문서화한다
anonymous fictional human remains lie fully supported on a rigid gurney under an opaque shroud
a transfer tag and two-person dignified handling establish mortuary context without exposed injury
positive_fields.definition: A declared fictional human-remains state represented through complete external support, absence of self-support or agency, a readable human contour or mortuary context, and dignified non-graphic handling. A still image cannot medically confirm real death, infer cause, or establish identity; sleep, unconsciousness, mannequins, empty shrouds, and reanimated bodies remain separate.

paraphrases: 입깃에서 오른쪽 앞섶의 사선 여밈과 개구리 단추가 이어지고 한 벌의 긴 몸판과 옆선 구조가 함께 보이는 치파오
a continuous calf-length dress whose standing collar flows into a diagonal frog-fastened front line
a straight or fitted qipao body with controlled side slits that belong to the sewn garment rather than a torn opening
positive_fields.definition: A qipao or cheongsam is a continuous dress system whose high standing collar connects to a curved or diagonal upper-front opening secured by knotted frog fastenings, with the fitted or straight body and coherent side construction remaining visible. Length, fit, sleeve, fabric, and slit height vary by period and design; a standing collar alone is never sufficient.

paraphrases: 맞음새 있는 앞여밈 자수 블라우스의 중앙을 케롱상 브로치가 잇고 아래에 별도 사롱이 감긴 케바야
a fitted embroidered voile kebaya blouse whose linked center brooches bridge the front edges above a wrapped sarong
a long or short kebaya upper garment with visible front fastening and a clearly separate patterned lower wrap
positive_fields.definition: A kebaya system pairs a shaped front-opening upper garment, commonly made from fine embroidered, lace, or lightweight cloth, with a visible center fastening such as buttons or a kerongsang brooch set and a distinct wrapped lower garment such as a sarong. Regional forms vary in length, opacity, fit, material, and fastening, so translucency or lace is supportive rather than mandatory by itself.

paraphrases: 한 장의 사리 천이 허리를 감고 앞쪽 여러 주름으로 턱인 뒤 몸통을 가로질러 왼쪽 어깨 팔루로 이어지는 니비식 드레이프
one continuous sari cloth forms tucked front pleats before crossing diagonally to a left-shoulder pallu
the blouse and underskirt remain separate support layers while the sari cloth route stays uninterrupted
positive_fields.definition: The Nivi sari is one specific sari-draping system in which a continuous length of cloth wraps the waist, forms aligned front pleats tucked into an underskirt, crosses the torso, and sends the free pallu over the left shoulder, commonly over a separate blouse. This topology must not be projected onto every regional sari drape.

paraphrases: 중앙 목구멍을 기준으로 넓은 직조 앞뒤 패널이 어깨에서 내려오고 옆면은 팔 주위로 열린 안데스 판초
a woven rectangular outer cloth whose central neck opening feeds broad front and back panels
the open side drape and hand-finished panel edges remain visible while the textile spreads in wind
positive_fields.definition: An Andean poncho is a rectangular or near-rectangular woven outer garment organized around a central head opening, with broad uninterrupted panels falling down the front and back and the sides remaining open enough to drape around the arms. Weave, color, motif, fiber, finishing, and dimensions vary by place and period; stripes or highland scenery alone are not proof.
concepts: continuous woven bands and finished edges

concept_terms: continuous woven bands and finished edges

paraphrases: 어깨에서 몸판과 넓은 소매구멍이 하나의 큰 직사각 볼륨으로 이어지고 목선 자수와 안쪽 랩이 함께 보이는 그랑 부부
an expansive grand-boubou outer body whose broad sleeve apertures and embroidered neckline remain legible over a coordinated inner layer
one arm movement opens the cloth volume while the opposite side still shows the continuous center-front axis
positive_fields.definition: A West African grand boubou is an expansive outer garment whose near-rectangular cloth body produces very broad sleeve openings and a continuous shoulder-to-body volume, often focused by embroidery around the neck or center front and worn with a coordinated inner garment or wrapper. Regional and gendered forms vary; volume, embroidery, color, or a generic robe alone is not sufficient, and agbada remains a related but separately named ensemble.

paraphrases: two living human bodies linked by one documented genomic lineage while retaining individual developmental details
an original and a cloned person connected through tissue-culture and DNA provenance
기계 복제가 아니라 생물학적 계통 기록으로 연결된 원본 인간과 복제 인간
유전적 기원은 공유하지만 주근깨와 머리 모양과 표정은 개별적으로 발달한 두 사람
positive_fields.definition: A biological human clone is defined by copied genetic origin and a source-lineage relation, not by machine manufacture or a compulsory pixel-identical appearance. Shared heredity may support related features, while development and environment may produce visible phenotype variation.
concepts: source and copy documented in one scene

concept_terms: source and copy documented in one scene

paraphrases: one coherent human body whose tissue map reveals two genetically distinct cell populations
dual-origin cell-line distributions integrated across ordinary human organs
정상적인 인간 신체 안에 서로 다른 두 세포 계통이 통합되어 있음을 조직 영상으로 보여 준다
동물 부위가 아니라 세포 계통의 차이를 과학적 영상으로 드러낸 인간
positive_fields.definition: A human cellular chimera contains integrated cell populations derived from genetically distinct origins. The scientific condition is a cellular-lineage property and does not inherently create visible animal-part patchwork, split skin, monster anatomy, or a fantasy hybrid silhouette.
concepts: dual-origin cells within the same organs

concept_terms: dual-origin cells within the same organs

paraphrases: microscopic irregular spheroids assembled from living adult human airway cells and propelled by surface cilia
a microfluidic culture shows ciliated multicellular biobots moving across damaged tissue
성인 인간 기관지 세포가 자가조립한 현미경 크기의 불규칙한 섬모 생체로봇
사람 모양이 아니라 표면 섬모로 움직이는 세포 응집체
positive_fields.definition: An Anthrobot is a microscopic motile living biobot that self-assembles from adult human tracheal epithelial cells into an irregular multicellular body whose outward cilia drive movement. Human cellular origin does not imply a human face, limbs, humanoid silhouette, metal chassis, or android scale.

paraphrases: a physical person sends current sensor state into a digital counterpart and receives a changed prediction back
the same person's pose and physiology update a full-scale model that returns a new route or intervention
실제 인간의 센서 상태가 디지털 대응체로 들어가고 예측 결과가 다시 실제 환경으로 돌아오는 양방향 관계
정적인 닮은꼴 아바타가 아니라 지속적으로 갱신되는 운용 모델
positive_fields.definition: A human digital twin is an operational digital counterpart tied to a specific physical person through continuing state exchange. A still image must show the physical referent, live sensing into the model, and a visible returned update or prediction; a photoreal avatar, static scan, digital double, or one-way dashboard alone is insufficient.

paraphrases: living muscle bands contract inside a transparent engineered scaffold and bend polymer fins
an independent soft robot couples cultured tissue to electrodes and synthetic structure
살아 있는 수축성 조직이 합성 골격과 전극에 연결되어 실제 움직임을 만드는 로봇
동물 모양을 흉내 낸 완전 합성 로봇이 아니라 생체 조직과 공학 구조가 기능적으로 통합된 기계
positive_fields.definition: A biohybrid robot functionally integrates living biological material such as cells or contractile muscle with engineered synthetic structures, electrodes, control components, or scaffolds. Its living and synthetic parts must jointly produce movement or sensing; animal-inspired shape alone and an organism merely wearing a device are different concepts.

paraphrases: low brand prominence with matte fine wool, exact tailoring and restrained hardware
로고 과시 없이 재료 표면과 재단, 접합부 정밀도가 함께 보이는 스타일
positive_fields.definition: Quiet luxury is a low-brand-prominence visual grammar in which natural material variation, precise cut or fit, exact junctions, and restrained hardware do the visible work. Beige minimalism, plain basics, an empty room, or a wealthy-looking person alone cannot establish it, and pixels do not prove actual wealth, price, rarity, provenance, or authenticity.

paraphrases: a large original emblem and repeated geometric code integrated into leather and hardware
실제 로고가 아닌 오리지널 비문자 표식과 반복 모티프가 물성과 구조에 통합된 과시적 스타일
positive_fields.definition: Conspicuous luxury uses high visual prominence of an original fictional non-letter emblem, repeated geometric motif, and distinctive hardware across a coherent constructed object or display. It must not copy a real trademark, readable brand name, monogram, or product design; random text, generic gold-and-black clutter, and counterfeiting are different concepts.

paraphrases: a basted toile is corrected on the client while internal support and hand embroidery remain visible
개별 토일 피팅과 내부 지지층, 손자수 부착 공정이 한 장면에 연결됨
positive_fields.definition: Couture atelier craft is individualized garment construction evidenced by a basted toile or client-specific form, live fitting or draping corrections, layered internal support, and hand attachment or finishing. A finished gown, runway show, red-carpet glamour, or ready-to-wear rack is insufficient, and pixels cannot prove legal Haute Couture accreditation.

paraphrases: a master cutter adjusts one client's paper pattern beside the same client's basted fitting
개인별 종이 패턴과 베이스팅 피팅 수정, 손캔버스 내부가 같은 고객의 공정으로 연결됨
positive_fields.definition: Bespoke tailoring is one-client pattern ownership and iterative construction: an individually drafted paper pattern, a basted fitting with visible balance corrections, hand-canvassed or hand-worked internal structure, and retained records or aftercare. Made-to-measure stock-pattern adjustment, simple alterations, and a well-fitted finished suit portrait are different concepts.

paraphrases: a rigid wood frame receives fitted covering before reinforced corners and locks are attached
목재 프레임과 피복, 코너 보강, 잠금장치가 여행 보호 기능으로 연결된 트래블 오브제
positive_fields.definition: Heritage travel-object craft is a brand-neutral protective construction system: a balanced rigid frame, fitted canvas or leather covering, reinforced corners and attached working hardware, plus compartments or other travel-protection function. A suitcase silhouette, decorative luggage prop, patina, or monogram surface alone is insufficient and does not prove provenance.

paraphrases: matched stones are secured by visible prongs into one original metal gallery
크기와 색이 맞춰진 보석이 프롱·베젤 접점과 금속 지지구조에 통합됨
positive_fields.definition: High-jewelry craft is a mechanically legible integration of matched gemstones and an original supporting metal design. Stone size or color matching, prong, bezel, pavé, or another setting contact, supporting gallery or structure, and bench placement or inspection must work together. Loose gems, generic sparkle, costume jewelry, and price or rarity claims are insufficient.

paraphrases: connected bridges and gear train show brushed planes, polished chamfers and active adjustment
연결된 기계식 무브먼트에 브러싱·폴리시·앵글라주 차등 마감과 조립 맥락이 함께 보임
positive_fields.definition: Fine-watchmaking craft joins a coherent mechanical movement and connected timekeeping function with differentiated finishing such as chamfering, polishing, brushing, engraving, or hand decoration, plus an assembly or adjustment context. Loose gears, a printed skeleton motif, a smartwatch display, or a status portrait cannot establish it.
concepts: assembly or regulation under a loupe

concept_terms: assembly or regulation under a loupe

paraphrases: one advisor compares a curated few materials against the client's fit need and records the chosen aftercare
한 명의 상담자가 고객 요구에 맞춰 소수 선택지를 다루고 피팅·애프터케어까지 연결함
positive_fields.definition: Private-client luxury is a responsive one-to-one service interaction: one advisor attends to one client's stated material, fit, function, or care need; presents a curated few; handles or fits them carefully; and leaves an aftercare, repair, or restoration continuation. An empty marble lobby, champagne, velvet rope, private room, or salesperson pose alone is insufficient.

paraphrases: 앞 플래킷과 별도로 좌우 칼라 끝이 작은 단추로 몸판에 고정된 셔츠
both pointed collar tips are separately buttoned down above a complete front placket
the collar remains readable as a point collar rather than a printed or button-like decoration
positive_fields.definition: A shirt topology with a complete center-front button placket and a point collar whose left and right collar tips are each visibly fastened to the shirt body by their own small buttons. The collar-point fastening, not the generic front opening, distinguishes it from an ordinary button-up shirt.
concepts: collar points attached to shirt body

concept_terms: collar points attached to shirt body

paraphrases: 네크라인과 양쪽 소매가 유지된 채 어깨 윗부분에만 경계 있는 창이 열린 탑
paired shoulder windows sit between a continuous neckline and attached sleeves
finished cutout seams and fabric bridges keep each sleeve connected
positive_fields.definition: A top whose neckline or upper bodice remains continuous while one bounded opening exposes each shoulder top and the sleeve continues below each opening. Finished edges and fabric bridges preserve the garment route around the cutouts, distinguishing it from an off-shoulder neckline, a sleeveless top, or torn fabric.

paraphrases: 두 앞판이 사선으로 실제 겹치고 한쪽이 아래로 이어져 옆에서 고정되는 블라우스
two traceable front edges cross into a functional side fastening and wrap V neckline
the lower panel remains visible beneath the upper panel through fold depth and edge continuity
positive_fields.definition: A functional wrap-front upper garment formed by two separately traceable front panels crossing diagonally, with one panel continuing beneath the other and a side tie, button, or fixed seam holding the overlap. The crossing creates a coherent wrap V neckline and edge path rather than a decorative diagonal print, faux seam, or loose scarf.
concepts: functional side tie button or seam

concept_terms: functional side tie button or seam

paraphrases: 상체에서 허리와 가랑이까지 한 벌로 이어진 뒤 두 바지통으로 갈라지는 의복
one upper garment continues through a real crotch before separating into two leg openings
the selected long or short leg variant remains legible without turning into a dress or two-piece set
positive_fields.definition: One garment whose upper section continues through the waist into a real crotch and then bifurcates into two separate leg openings. A selected jumpsuit variant normally carries longer trouser legs, while a romper or playsuit carries short legs; the upper-to-crotch continuity, inseam, and two-leg topology distinguish every variant from a dress or coordinated separates.
concepts: long jumpsuit or short romper variant
distinct from dress and matching separates

concept_terms: long jumpsuit or short romper variant
distinct from dress and matching separates

paraphrases: 허리밴드 아래 실제 가랑이와 인심이 있고 두 넓은 바지통이 종아리에서 따로 끝나는 하의
two calf-length wide legs separate clearly during a natural stride
the center rise and two hem openings remain readable despite a skirt-like standing silhouette
positive_fields.definition: A cropped trouser topology with one waistband and a real crotch or center rise that separates into two independently moving, wide leg volumes ending around the calf. The inseam, separate hem openings, and stride evidence distinguish culottes or gaucho trousers from a midi skirt, while the cropped length distinguishes them from full-length palazzo trousers.
concepts: distinct from midi skirt and palazzo trousers

concept_terms: distinct from midi skirt and palazzo trousers

paraphrases: 개별 안족 위의 여러 현을 오른손으로 뜯고 왼손으로 눌러 변음하는 가야금
a seated performer plucking a long bridge zither while the other hand presses strings beyond the bridges
positive_fields.definition: A long Korean horizontal wooden zither whose multiple strings each pass over an individual movable anjok bridge. In active performance the right hand plucks on one side of the bridges while the left hand presses or bends strings on the other side; this bridge-and-finger system distinguishes it from a fretted geomungo played with a suldae.

paraphrases: 고정 괘와 안족이 함께 있고 오른손 술대로 현을 타는 거문고
a seated performer striking a long fretted Korean zither with a short suldae
positive_fields.definition: A long Korean horizontal zither with a small set of strings, prominent fixed frets called gwae plus movable bridges, and a short suldae stick used by the right hand to strike or pluck. The fretted playing surface and suldae action distinguish it from a gayageum's many individual bridges and bare-finger pluck-press relation.

paraphrases: 싱글 리드 마우스피스와 키가 달린 굽은 금속관 색소폰
a curved keyed metal wind instrument played through a reed mouthpiece
positive_fields.definition: A curved alto or tenor saxophone with a single-reed mouthpiece and ligature, dense keyed metal body, conical tube, and flared bell. Lip contact at the reed mouthpiece and both hands on key clusters distinguish it from lip-reed brass instruments such as a trumpet.

paraphrases: 컵 마우스피스와 세 피스톤 밸브가 있는 현대 트럼펫
a compact valved brass instrument played with lip buzz and three valve fingers
positive_fields.definition: A modern piston trumpet with compact folded brass tubing, a cup mouthpiece, three aligned piston valves, tuning slides, and a forward flared bell. Lip buzz at the cup mouthpiece and valve-finger contact distinguish it from reed-driven keyed winds such as a saxophone.

paraphrases: 앉은 연주자의 무릎 사이에서 엔드핀으로 바닥 지지되는 첼로
an upright bowed string body between the knees with its endpin on the floor
positive_fields.definition: A cello-sized bowed string instrument held upright between a seated player's knees, supported by an endpin on the floor. The right hand bows the strings while the left hand fingers the neck; the seated between-knees relation and medium floor-supported scale distinguish it from violin-family shoulder support and the much larger double bass.

paraphrases: 연주자 키에 가까운 대형 공명통과 긴 넥을 바닥 엔드핀으로 세운 더블베이스
a standing performer beside a human-scale upright bass, bowing or plucking its strings
positive_fields.definition: A human-scale upright double bass with a large waisted body, long neck rising near or above the player's head, and an endpin bearing weight on the floor. The performer stands or uses a high stool while bowing or plucking; this scale and support relation distinguish it from a cello held between the knees of a conventionally seated player.

paraphrases: 금속 건반 아래 공명관과 회전 팬, 댐퍼 페달이 있는 비브라폰
a standing player using mallets and a pedal on a metal-bar keyboard percussion instrument
positive_fields.definition: A vibraphone with two rows of graduated metal bars, vertical resonator tubes containing visible rotating-fan assemblies, a damper pedal and frame, and mallets striking the bars. Metal bars plus motor-fan and pedal evidence distinguish it from wooden-bar xylophones and marimbas.

paraphrases: 두 줄의 목재 바를 단단한 말렛으로 치는 오케스트라 실로폰
a wooden-bar keyboard percussion instrument with compact resonators
positive_fields.definition: An orchestral xylophone with two rows of graduated wooden bars on a frame, compact resonators beneath, and hard mallets striking the bars. Visible wood grain and the absence of a vibraphone's metal bars, motor fans, and damper pedal distinguish the instrument.

paraphrases: 수직 피치 안테나와 루프형 볼륨 안테나 사이에서 두 손을 비접촉으로 움직이는 테레민
two separated hands shape pitch and volume in air around distinct antennas
positive_fields.definition: A powered theremin cabinet with one straight pitch antenna and one loop-shaped volume antenna. The performer keeps two separated hands suspended in the electromagnetic fields without touching the instrument, one hand controlling pitch distance and the other volume distance; this dual-antenna noncontact relation distinguishes it from a MIDI controller or generic gesture sensor.

paraphrases: 건반이나 패드를 누르면 연결된 컴퓨터 소프트웨어 악기가 소리를 내는 MIDI 컨트롤러
hands operating pads and knobs while a connected sound module is visibly active
positive_fields.definition: A MIDI performance controller whose visible keys or pads, knobs and transport controls generate performance data for a separately visible computer, software instrument, or sound module. The performer touches the control surface and the connected external sound-producing destination remains legible; the controller is not represented as a self-contained acoustic or synthesizer sound source.

paraphrases: 손을 감싸는 복잡한 가드와 가느다란 직선 양날 검신이 뾰족한 끝으로 이어지는 레이피어
a slender thrusting sword whose ornate swept guard, one-hand grip, pommel, and acute point share one readable profile
positive_fields.definition: A rapier morphology with a long slender straight double-edged blade tapering to an acute point, an elaborate swept or cup guard around the grip, a one-hand grip, and a pommel on one continuous hilt-to-blade axis. Blade proportion and protective guard topology distinguish it from a broad two-hand greatsword, a short smallsword silhouette, or a plain cruciform medieval sword.

paraphrases: 하나의 긴 자루 위에 옆 도끼날·위쪽 창끝·뒤쪽 부리나 스파이크가 함께 결합된 할버드
a full-profile polearm whose axe blade, spear point, rear beak, socket, and continuous shaft are simultaneously legible
positive_fields.definition: A halberd morphology whose single long continuous shaft carries one integrated head with a lateral axe blade, an apical spear point, and a rear beak or spike. All three head functions and their socket-to-shaft relation must be readable together, preventing a spear-only, glaive-only, poleaxe, or oversized fantasy axe substitution.

paraphrases: 중앙 라이저·분할 림·양끝 캠·서로 분리된 보우스트링과 케이블 경로가 보이는 컴파운드 보우
a vertical modern bow whose paired cams and distinct cable paths remain visible from limb tip to limb tip
a modern bow whose paired cams and distinct cable paths remain visible from limb tip to limb tip
positive_fields.definition: A compound bow morphology built around a rigid central riser, split or compact limbs, cams or pulleys at both limb tips, and visibly separate bowstring and cable paths. The complete bow remains independent of a stock, preventing a recurve or longbow without cams and preventing a crossbow substitution.

paraphrases: 세로 스톡과 볼트 트랙 위에 가로 활대·줄·발사 기구가 직각으로 결합된 석궁
a crosswise prod and string mechanically integrated with a longitudinal stock, bolt track, and release housing
positive_fields.definition: A crossbow morphology that joins a longitudinal stock and bolt track to a transverse prod, one spanning string, and a visible release mechanism. The perpendicular stock-to-prod topology and coherent trigger region distinguish it from an ordinary vertical bow, a rifle-shaped stock without a prod, or a detached bow mounted ambiguously near a stock.

paraphrases: 프레임 안 다중 약실 실린더와 그중 한 약실 축에 맞는 총열·그립·방아쇠울이 보이는 리볼버 외형
a side profile whose chambered cylinder, frame, aligned barrel, trigger guard, grip, and optional hammer read as one revolver form
positive_fields.definition: A revolver external morphology with a prominent multi-chamber cylinder held inside a frame, a barrel aligned with one chamber, a distinct grip and trigger guard, and an optional visible hammer. The side-readable cylinder-to-barrel relationship distinguishes it from a semi-automatic pistol whose slide and detachable-magazine silhouette replace the chambered cylinder.

paraphrases: 비스듬히 세운 포신이 양각대와 지면 바닥판에 함께 연결되고 조준·조절 장치가 보이는 지상 박격포
a crew-served ground mount whose elevated tube, bipod, baseplate, sight, and adjustment hardware remain mechanically connected
positive_fields.definition: A ground-emplaced mortar system whose elevated launch tube is seated on a ground-contacting baseplate and stabilized by a connected bipod with visible sight or traverse-and-elevation hardware. The tube, mount, and baseplate must form one scale-coherent assembly, preventing a kitchen mortar and pestle, wheeled cannon, shoulder launcher, or unsupported tube substitution.

paraphrases: 이륙 기와 처마와 도착 지붕 사이를 성인 무인이 장포 지연과 함께 건너는 경공 이동
one adult martial traveler crosses a gap between old tiled roofs with start path and landing direction simultaneously legible
positive_fields.definition: A human-scale wuxia qinggong traversal across old tiled roofs. One adult martial traveler must occupy an intermediate trajectory whose takeoff eave, airborne path, destination roof, and coherent cloth lag are all visible together. The relation distinguishes qinggong traversal from a static roof portrait, a modern rooftop jump, unsupported levitation, winged flight, broom flight, or xianxia flying-sword travel.

paraphrases: 수직 죽림 깊이 안에서 두 성인 무인의 상승·하강 경로와 교환 지점이 분리되는 경공 결투
two adult martial rivals cross distinct aerial paths among vertical bamboo with one shared exchange and separate landing anchors
positive_fields.definition: A two-adult wuxia duel whose action geography is owned by a bamboo forest. Vertical trunks and canopy depth keep both martial silhouettes separate while their opposed trajectories, one shared exchange point, and distinct support or landing zones remain visible. The contract rejects a generic bamboo portrait, one-person sword pose, merged fighters, ordinary ground sparring, or unanchored xianxia levitation.

paraphrases: 객잔 문턱·탁자·계단 구역에 나뉜 성인 강호인들이 식사 흔적을 유지한 채 시선과 손으로 정체를 떠보는 대치
adult jianghu travelers hold separate inn zones and exchange watchful eyelines while meal objects remain undisturbed before combat
positive_fields.definition: A pre-conflict jianghu standoff inside a sparse frontier inn. Adult travelers occupy at least two distinct doorway, table, or stair zones; their physically compatible eyelines and controlled hands test identities while ordinary bowls, cups, and service remain visibly intact. The all-of relation separates the scene from an empty historical restaurant, a Western saloon, a generic fantasy tavern, a friendly meal, or an open melee that has erased watchful restraint.

paraphrases: 경계가 보이는 비무 공간에서 정확히 두 명의 성인 무인이 중앙 간격을 사이에 두고 서로를 향해 동시에 포권례를 하는 접촉 전 대치
exactly two adult martial competitors exchange simultaneous palm-and-fist salutes across a clean pre-contact gap in one bounded contest space
positive_fields.definition: A formal pre-contact contest between exactly two adult martial competitors. Both face each other and simultaneously perform a reciprocal palm-and-fist salute across a clean center gap inside one bounded courtyard or platform, while witnesses remain subordinate and outside the contest axis. The all-of relation distinguishes the scene from solo forms practice, an active brawl, modern boxing or MMA, military drill, a handshake, or a posed ceremony photograph.

paraphrases: 가해자의 즉각적 위협선과 여행자 사이에 성인 개입자가 실제로 들어가 공격을 막거나 피할 틈을 만드는 세 역할 무협 사건
a distinct adult intervener enters the aggressor-to-traveler threat line and visibly blocks or redirects it to create an escape opening
positive_fields.definition: A visible three-role wuxia event in which one adult aggressor directs an immediate physical threat toward a distinct traveler or civilian, and a distinct adult intervener physically enters that same threat line to block, redirect, or create an escape opening. The protective relation must be readable from positions and consequences; costume, facial expression, reputation, title, or presumed virtue cannot prove the xia relation by themselves.

paraphrases: 표국 문 또는 적재 마당에서 봉인된 상자와 짐을 실은 운송 수단이 도로로 이어지고 성인 무장 호송인이 화물 둘레에 배치된 출발 장면
adult martial escorts distribute around sealed cargo loaded on a coherent transport unit departing a bureau yard through a gate onto one continuous road
positive_fields.definition: A guarded commercial departure from a biaoju loading yard or gate onto a continuous road. Sealed boxes or bundled cargo visibly load a cart, pack animal, or coherent transport unit; adult martial escorts distribute around that owned load and orient along its route. The cargo-protection relation, not readable signage or costume alone, separates the scene from an army convoy, merchant-only caravan, adventuring party, empty courtyard, or generic wagon.

paraphrases: 서로 다른 두 공간이 하나의 경계면을 통해 동시에 보이고 인물이나 사물이 그 경계를 실제로 통과하는 차원문
a bounded interworld threshold with distinct near and far spaces, coherent crossing occlusion, and localized residue
positive_fields.definition: A bounded threshold that simultaneously connects two visibly distinct spaces and supports a coherent crossing relation. The boundary, near-side space, far-side space, occlusion continuity, and localized crossing consequence must coexist; a glowing ring, mirror, window, or decorative arch alone is not a portal.

paraphrases: 살아 있는 시전자가 한정된 소환원에서 별개의 존재 하나를 불러내고 그 도착 반응과 흔적이 이어지는 장면
a living operator, bounded source, separately arriving entity, directional response, and localized arrival consequence
positive_fields.definition: A living operator causes one distinct entity to arrive from a bounded source or threshold. The operator, source, separate arriving entity, directional response, and local consequence must form one causal event; a companion portrait, empty magic circle, generic spell glow, or dead-body response does not establish summoning.

paraphrases: 연결된 증류·가열 장치에서 입력 재료와 다른 출력 상태가 동시에 비교되고 변환 경계와 잔류물이 보이는 연금술 작업
an operator-driven apparatus path with paired material states, localized transformation, and physical residue
positive_fields.definition: A practitioner uses connected workshop apparatus to transform a visible input material into a visibly different output state. Practitioner action, apparatus path, before-and-after material evidence, localized transition, and residue must coexist; costume, potion bottles, colored smoke, or a modern laboratory portrait alone is insufficient.

paraphrases: 점토나 돌 조각이 관절까지 재료적으로 이어진 한 몸을 이루고 활성화 반응과 실제 과업 흔적을 남기는 골렘
one assembled nonliving-material body with coherent joints, activation response, grounded motion, and task consequence
positive_fields.definition: One independently acting body is visibly assembled from clay, stone, earth, wood, or another nonliving material and remains materially continuous through its joints. Construction seams, activation response, grounded motion, and task consequence establish agency; a statue, costume, metal robot, rubble pile, or sacred inscription alone does not.

paraphrases: 열린 바이저나 관절 틈 안쪽이 비어 있으면서 완전한 판금 껍질이 스스로 움직이고 주변 사물에 결과를 남기는 살아 있는 갑옷
a complete articulated armor shell with a visibly hollow interior, coherent independent motion, and physical consequence

Emptiness, darkness, decay, yellow corridors, or horror imagery alone do not establish liminality.

paraphrases: 세탁소 직원이 천장에서 내리는 작은 물고기를 피하지 않고 같은 다림질을 계속한다
commuters calmly queue while one impossible rain cloud waters only a ticket machine and leaves a real puddle
an ordinary baker adjusts a tray beside a loaf that slowly floats yet still casts one coherent workbench shadow
positive_fields.definition: An otherwise concrete everyday reality contains one impossible occurrence that characters treat as an ordinary fact while continuing practical activity, and the occurrence shares the scene's material light, contact, occlusion, and consequence. It is a narrative relation, not a prescribed regional aesthetic, costume, palette, or spectacle.

paraphrases: 실물은 컵을 내려놓았지만 같은 옷과 방에 정렬된 거울상은 아직 컵을 들고 있다
the physical subject looks down while the matching aligned reflection independently meets the camera
one clear hand gesture differs across the mirror while every room edge and clothing marker still corresponds
positive_fields.definition: A physical subject and the corresponding geometrically aligned mirror image appear in the same frame with matching identity, scale, clothing, and room markers, while one action, gaze, or temporal phase differs. Ordinary reflection, twins, montage, optical warping, and double exposure do not establish independent reflection agency.

paraphrases: 나무의 두 옹이와 갈라진 틈이 눈과 입처럼 보이지만 목재 결은 끝까지 이어진다
two facade windows and a vent form a face-like arrangement while every element remains functional architecture
cloud cavities create a fleeting face reading without adding eyes paint or sculpted features
positive_fields.definition: Ordinary components of a clearly nonface substrate such as wood, rock, cloud, stains, architecture, or an appliance align into a face-like configuration while their original material identity remains fully legible. An actual face, mask, sculpture, painting, sticker, or inserted eyes does not count as face pareidolia.

paraphrases: 한 팔의 인간 피부와 손가락이 비늘과 날개 뼈로 점진 연결되어 같은 몸의 도착 형태로 이어진다
one wooden figure keeps its carved torso while a continuous grain-to-feather bridge becomes a living bird wing
source fibers, intermediate membrane, and target scales occupy connected regions of one moving subject
positive_fields.definition: One identifiable subject simultaneously shows a readable source form, a readable target form, and an unbroken anatomical, material, or topological transition zone connecting them, with residue or directional evidence indicating one change path. Separate before-after figures, costume changes, overlays, attached decorations, or a completed target alone do not prove metamorphosis.

paraphrases: 이동식 환등기의 광추가 연무 스크린에 닿고 운영자가 거리를 바꾸자 해골상이 커진다
two lanterns switch a succession of spectral figures across one translucent screen while the apparatus remains visible
projected apparitions change scale and position along a bounded light cone inside a dark performance chamber
positive_fields.definition: A staged spectral sequence produced by visible lantern or projector apparatus, a traceable light path, and a wall, smoke, or translucent receiving surface, with image replacement or scale change tied to operator or apparatus movement. A real ghost, hologram, fog silhouette, projector alone, or generic horror collage is not phantasmagoria in this historical projection sense.

paraphrases: 원초의 물속으로 내려간 한 존재가 흙 한 줌을 회수해 수면으로 돌아오고 그 흙에서 최초의 땅이 퍼져 나간다
one diving agent brings sediment from beneath a shoreless ocean and the same clod begins expanding into land
positive_fields.definition: A landless primordial water field contains one diver who retrieves a small amount of earth, returns it to the surface, and visibly initiates the first land from that same material. Swimming wildlife, ordinary mud, or an already completed island does not establish the creation chain.

paraphrases: 원초의 알 하나가 갈라지는 경계에서 내부 물질과 껍질이 하늘과 땅의 질서로 이어진다
a single cosmic egg ruptures and its own shell and interior visibly organize into world layers
positive_fields.definition: One bounded primordial egg is shown before and during a causal rupture in which its interior, shell, or contained matter becomes an ordered world. A decorative egg, ordinary hatching animal, or unrelated planet behind a cracked shell does not demonstrate cosmic creation.

paraphrases: 맞닿아 있던 하늘 부모와 땅 부모 사이를 한 분리자가 밀어 벌리고 그 틈에서 빛과 세계 공간이 생긴다
an active separator forces the contacting sky and earth parents apart until first light occupies the new interval
positive_fields.definition: A compressed sky-parent and earth-parent begin in contact, an active separating force opens a growing vertical interval between them, and light or habitable world space appears as the consequence. Two unrelated giants or an already open landscape does not show world-parent separation.

paraphrases: 하나의 중심축이 지하·지상·천상 세 영역을 관통하며 각 경계에서 물질과 방향이 바뀐다
a single centered world axis crosses lower middle and upper realms with traceable passage through both boundaries
positive_fields.definition: One centered vertical axis physically and compositionally connects distinct lower, middle, and upper realms through readable boundary crossings. A giant tree, tower, or mountain that merely occupies the background without realm-specific transitions is not sufficient.

paraphrases: 클로토가 뽑고 라케시스가 재며 아트로포스가 자르는 하나의 생명실이 세 역할을 연속적으로 연결한다
three fate figures occupy distinct spin measure and cut stations along one uninterrupted human life thread
positive_fields.definition: Three distinct Moirai perform complementary actions on one continuous mortal life thread: Clotho spins its origin, Lachesis measures its allotted length, and Atropos cuts its endpoint. Three women with yarn or a severed thread without role continuity does not express the allocation of a life.

paraphrases: 필멸자 시절의 표식을 지닌 같은 인물이 신적 존재들의 영접과 수여를 거쳐 새로운 신적 표지와 자리로 올라간다
one continuous mortal identity crosses a threshold where an established divine assembly receives and invests that person
positive_fields.definition: The same mortal remains identifiable across a staged transition into divine status through a retained mortal token, explicit reception or investiture by a divine order, and newly granted regalia or elevated placement. Mere levitation, glow, worship, or a deity replacing the mortal does not show apotheosis.

paraphrases: 살아 있음을 보여 주는 여행자가 지상 경계를 뒤로하고 목적물을 든 채 저승의 문 아래로 내려간다
one living hero moves from daylight through a guarded downward gate toward an underworld objective
positive_fields.definition: A demonstrably living traveler crosses a one-way downward threshold from the human world into a distinct underworld while carrying a visible objective, guide token, or retrieval purpose. Cave exploration, burial of a corpse, a dead soul being escorted, or directionless dark travel does not establish katabasis.

labels: Anubis weighing the heart against Ma'at's feather
paraphrases: 죽은 이 앞의 양팔 저울 한쪽에는 심장, 다른 쪽에는 마아트의 깃털이 있고 아누비스가 저울을 다루며 토트가 결과를 적는다
the deceased faces a heart-versus-feather balance attended by Anubis while Thoth records and judgment awaits
positive_fields.definition: An ancient Egyptian judgment scene shows the deceased before a two-pan balance where a heart is weighed against the feather of Ma'at, Anubis attends the weighing, Thoth records the result, and Ammit or Osiris establishes the consequence. Generic scales, Anubis alone, or mixed-pantheon judgment imagery is not equivalent.

paraphrases: 봉인된 생존선 안에 사람·동물·씨앗의 계보가 질서 있게 보존되고 세계를 덮은 물 밖에는 물러남이나 착지의 흔적이 보인다
one prepared vessel carries bounded living cargo through a world flood toward visible grounding or released-bird evidence
positive_fields.definition: A deliberately prepared and sealed vessel preserves a bounded lineage of people, animals, seeds, or provisions through a world-covering deluge, with both catastrophic water and post-flood recession, grounding, or release evidence visible. A storm boat, crowded ferry, or animals beside a ship does not establish mythic preservation.

labels: combat myth that establishes cosmic order
우주 질서를 세우는 혼돈 전투 신화
paraphrases: 질서의 챔피언이 원초 혼돈의 적과 싸워 쓰러뜨리고 그 결과 생긴 경계·분할·세계 물질이 새 우주 질서를 구성한다
one mythic combat moves from champion versus primordial adversary to a visibly ordered world made from the defeat consequence
positive_fields.definition: A named champion and a distinct primordial chaos adversary engage in traceable combat whose defeat directly produces or stabilizes cosmic order through partition, boundary, world matter, or sovereign placement. A dragon fight, monster slaying, or battle with no ordering consequence is not sufficient; named traditions must keep their own variant-specific lineage.

labels: solar-heated comet with coma and tails
paraphrases: a condensed comet head blooms into a hazy coma and a continuous tail whose vector points away from the illuminating Sun
태양 쪽의 응축된 머리를 코마가 감싸고 반대 방향으로 먼지나 이온 꼬리가 연속해서 뻗는다
positive_fields.definition: An active comet is read through a compact head embedded in a diffuse coma and one or more continuous tails directed away from the Sun; a bare asteroid, atmospheric meteor, or rocket plume is not equivalent.

paraphrases: an oblique face-on disk shows a bright bulge, a straight central stellar bar, and two arms curling from the bar tips
밝은 중심팽대부를 가로지르는 막대의 양 끝에서 나선팔이 이어지고 하나의 원반 안에 놓인다
positive_fields.definition: A barred spiral galaxy requires a central bulge crossed by an elongated stellar bar, with spiral arms beginning near the bar ends inside a common disk; a normal spiral, edge-on galaxy, or lens flare does not satisfy the morphology.

labels: galaxy merger tidal tails and bridge
paraphrases: two resolved galactic cores pull a luminous bridge between them while long tidal tails peel from their outer disks
서로 구별되는 두 은하핵 사이로 조석 다리가 이어지고 바깥 원반이 긴 꼬리로 휘어진다
positive_fields.definition: Interacting galaxies require at least two distinct galactic nuclei or bodies plus tidal tails, a bridge, shells, or asymmetric distortion that is visibly connected to their mutual encounter; unrelated neighboring galaxies are insufficient.

paraphrases: a foreground elliptical galaxy sits at the center of a thin tangential arc that nearly closes into a ring from a lensed background source
전경 렌즈 은하를 중심으로 배경 광원이 얇은 접선 방향 호나 거의 완전한 고리로 늘어난다
positive_fields.definition: An Einstein ring visualization requires a foreground lens mass centered within one nearly circular ring or matched arcs made from a more distant source, with tangential curvature and lens-source alignment; a halo, portal, black-hole ring, or planetary ring is not sufficient.

paraphrases: a sparse interferometric reconstruction shows a dark central shadow enclosed by a thick asymmetric millimeter-emission ring
측정 재구성 특유의 제한된 해상도 안에서 어두운 중심 그림자와 밝기가 비대칭인 방출 고리가 보인다
positive_fields.definition: A black-hole shadow reconstruction is a measurement-derived image with a central brightness depression enclosed by an uneven emission ring at event-horizon scale; it must not claim a direct photograph of a solid black sphere, eclipse, or portal.

labels: lensed far-side accretion disk around black hole
paraphrases: the far rim of a luminous accretion disk bends into upper and lower arcs around a dark shadow while the approaching side burns brighter
빛나는 원반의 먼 쪽이 블랙홀 그림자 위아래로 휘어 보이고 한쪽 가장자리가 상대적으로 밝다
positive_fields.definition: A relativistic black-hole accretion-disk visualization requires a luminous disk, a dark central shadow, the far side gravitationally lensed above and below the shadow, and Doppler-like brightness asymmetry; a planetary ring or generic fire vortex is not equivalent.

labels: protostellar disk with perpendicular twin jets
paraphrases: an obscured young stellar source sits in a dark flattened disk while paired jets pierce the envelope along the perpendicular axis
먼지 포락층 속 원시별과 납작한 원반을 가로질러 수직축 양쪽으로 제트 공동이 뚫린다
positive_fields.definition: A protostellar system requires an embedded young central source, a flattened circumstellar dust disk, and two opposed jets or outflow cavities approximately perpendicular to the disk, all within a surrounding envelope; a mature ringed star or hourglass nebula is insufficient.

paraphrases: a broken spherical web of shock-heated filaments marks an expanding front with compressed gas just outside and diffuse ejecta within
끊어진 필라멘트 껍질의 바깥 경계가 주변 가스를 밀어내고 내부에는 더 희박한 잔해가 남는다
positive_fields.definition: A supernova remnant is an expanding shell or filament network whose outer shock boundary sweeps surrounding material and encloses an evolved interior; a live stellar explosion, planetary nebula, or generic colorful cloud is not enough.

labels: aurora curtains with vertical rays above horizon
paraphrases: a long luminous arc folds into a curtain above the dark horizon while narrow rays rise vertically through the curtain
행성 지평선 위 긴 발광 호가 접힌 커튼으로 이어지고 그 안에서 가느다란 수직 광선이 솟는다
positive_fields.definition: An aurora scene requires emission above a planetary horizon or atmospheric context, organized as long arcs or folded curtains with field-aligned vertical rays; green clouds, a nebula, or light pollution do not establish auroral structure.

paraphrases: a vast arc of glowing plasma rises beyond the solar limb and returns to two separated footpoints on the chromosphere
태양 가장자리 밖으로 솟은 플라스마 고리가 두 발점으로 채층에 다시 연결된다
positive_fields.definition: A solar prominence visualization requires a visible solar limb and a coherent plasma arch whose two footpoints are anchored to the chromosphere, with loop-scale continuity; a detached flame, terrestrial fire, or generic coronal glow is insufficient.

labels: compact solar flare ribbons in active region
paraphrases: a magnetically complex sunspot region contains a compact saturated flash with paired bright ribbons and short coronal loops
복잡한 흑점 활동영역 안에서 국소적인 강한 섬광과 두 밝은 리본, 짧은 코로나 고리가 함께 나타난다
positive_fields.definition: A solar flare image requires a localized active region on the visible Sun with a compact, intense brightening or paired ribbons and immediate coronal response; a prominence loop, whole-disk glow, or detached CME front is a different structure.

paraphrases: a coronagraph's dark occulting disk hides the photosphere while a broad asymmetric plasma front expands through the outer corona
검은 차폐 원반이 태양광구를 가리고 그 바깥 코로나에서 넓은 비대칭 플라스마 전면이 바깥으로 팽창한다
positive_fields.definition: A coronal mass ejection coronagraph snapshot requires an occulting disk masking the bright Sun, a known solar-center marker or scale, and a broad outward-expanding plasma front in the surrounding corona; a solar flare, comet, or decorative halo is not equivalent.

paraphrases: a fully suited crew member outside the station braces on a handrail, safety tether clipped, life-support pack visible, and a gloved tool engaged with exterior hardware
우주선 외부에서 생명유지 배낭과 안전줄이 보이는 승무원이 손잡이에 몸을 고정하고 장갑 낀 도구로 외부 장치를 작업한다
positive_fields.definition: An EVA work scene requires a suited crew member outside a spacecraft, a visible life-support backpack, a restraint system such as tether, handrail, or foot restraint, and direct task contact with exterior hardware; an indoor costume portrait or free-floating pose is insufficient.

labels: free-floating station interior with no shared down
paraphrases: inside a station module, a crew member and loose objects float unsupported at different orientations while fingertips use a handrail to arrest motion
정거장 모듈 안에서 사람과 물체가 서로 다른 방향으로 떠 있고 손끝은 손잡이로 이동을 멈춘다
positive_fields.definition: A microgravity station interior requires recognizable orbital-habitat hardware, multiple unsupported free-floating bodies or objects, differing local orientations without a shared down direction, and handrails or restraints used for control; jumping, levitation, or lying on a rotated set is insufficient.

paraphrases: two opposed docking rings share one centerline as guide petals meet and capture latches begin engaging
마주 보는 두 도킹 인터페이스가 하나의 중심축에 놓이고 가이드 구조가 맞닿으며 포획 래치가 걸리기 시작한다
positive_fields.definition: A docking scene requires two opposed spacecraft or modules with compatible interfaces on a shared approach axis, close alignment, and visible soft-capture or hard-mate contact evidence; a flyby, formation flight, collision, or unrelated rings is insufficient.

paraphrases: a grounded rover braces beside an outcrop while its articulated instrument contacts one rock target and a fresh drill trace or sample tube records the operation
지면에 닿은 이동형 로버가 노두 옆에 정지해 관절식 장비로 한 암석을 접촉하고 새 천공 흔적이나 시료관이 결과를 보여준다
positive_fields.definition: A planetary rover operation requires a mobile surface vehicle with grounded mobility hardware, a visible science instrument or sampling mechanism interacting with a specific target, and an immediate trace or collected result; wheel count is mission-specific and must not be universalized.

labels: credible threat against a specific person
paraphrases: 한 성인이 다른 특정 성인의 퇴로를 막고 위해를 예고하는 손짓과 요구를 하며 대상이 그 행위자에게서 물러선다
one adult directs an imminent-harm gesture and coercive demand at a named target whose guarded retreat answers that same threat
positive_fields.definition: An interpersonal threat scene shows one identifiable actor directing a credible threat of harm at one specific adult target, a coercive communication or gesture, and an immediate target response tied to that threat. General hostility, ominous styling, weapons without a directed target, and abstract danger indicators are insufficient.

paraphrases: 한 성인의 가격 동작이 특정 성인의 방어 자세와 같은 접점의 즉각적인 균형 붕괴로 이어진다
the assailant's force reaches one target at a visible contact point and produces an immediate defensive or balance response
positive_fields.definition: A physical assault scene shows an adult assailant applying unwanted bodily force to a specific adult target, direct contact or immediate impact, and a localized bodily or environmental consequence at that same contact. Sport, mutual sparring, staged choreography, accidental collision, and aftermath without causality are separate.

paraphrases: 가해자가 특정 피해자에게 위해를 가하며 피해자의 지갑이 피해자 손에서 가해자 쪽으로 넘어간다
an offender coerces one victim while a wallet visibly crosses from the victim's possession into the offender's control
positive_fields.definition: A robbery scene requires an adult offender using force or a credible threat against a specific adult victim to obtain property, with the property visibly transferring from victim control toward offender control. Theft without confrontation, assault without property, consensual payment, and found property do not satisfy the relation.

paraphrases: 성인 가해자가 특정 성인의 퇴로를 막고 차량 문 쪽으로 강제로 이동시키며 대상은 반대 방향으로 버틴다
an abductor controls one adult captive and forces them along a visible path toward a vehicle or enclosed destination
positive_fields.definition: An adult abduction scene shows one or more abductors depriving a specific adult target of freedom and forcing that target from one place toward another, with a visible control method and a directional relocation path. Arrest, rescue, consensual travel, and restraint without relocation are not equivalent.

paraphrases: 성인 억류자가 특정 성인 인질을 통제하며 통신 장치로 외부 당국에 요구를 전달한다
a captor visibly controls one adult hostage while directing a conditional demand to authorities outside the captive pair
positive_fields.definition: A hostage-taking scene requires an adult captor controlling a specific adult hostage, a communicated threat tied to that hostage, and a demand directed at a distinct third party such as authorities or an organization. Captivity or kidnapping without third-party compulsion is not a hostage relation.

paraphrases: 허구 장면에서 성인 가해자의 의도적 치명 행위가 특정 성인 피해자에게 직접 이어지고 같은 접점에 비가역적 결과가 남는다
a declared fictional perpetrator's deliberate fatal action reaches one adult victim and produces a same-location terminal consequence
positive_fields.definition: A declared fictional intentional-homicide scene shows an adult perpetrator deliberately applying a fatal action to one specific adult victim and a localized terminal consequence tied to that action. A still image cannot medically verify real death, legal culpability, identity, or exact cause; accident, self-harm, combat, and aftermath without a causal actor remain separate.

paraphrases: 허구의 성인 조직이 지휘·감시·운반·장물 처리 역할을 나눠 하나의 불법 물류 흐름과 수익 기록을 공유한다
a fictional continuing group divides command surveillance transport and resale roles around one serious illegal operation and common proceeds trail
positive_fields.definition: A declared fictional organized-crime operation shows a continuing adult group with differentiated roles coordinating one serious illegal objective for material benefit, plus a shared operational trace connecting those roles. Gang styling, matching clothes, a meeting, or lawful logistics alone do not establish the organization or crime.

paraphrases: 성인 방화범의 점화 동작이 특정 건물 출입구의 한 발화점에 닿고 그 지점에서 새 불꽃과 연기가 퍼진다
a fire-setter's deliberate ignition reaches one property target and a fresh flame front grows from the same introduced point
positive_fields.definition: A deliberate arson scene shows an adult fire-setter intentionally initiating fire at a specific property target, a coherent ignition point or introduced fuel path, and new flame or smoke growth beginning from that same point. A building already burning, wildfire, accident, firefighting, and ceremonial flame are insufficient.

paraphrases: 성인 침입자가 갓 파손한 잠금장치를 통과해 실내의 특정 보관함을 탐색하며 파편이 같은 문턱에 남는다
an intruder crosses a freshly defeated lock and the same path leads toward a specific interior property target
positive_fields.definition: A burglary scene shows an adult intruder crossing a secured building boundary without authorization, fresh entry defeat at that exact boundary, and a linked criminal objective inside such as targeted property or evidence of search. Mere trespass, lawful locksmith work, rescue entry, and theft outdoors are different.

paraphrases: 선행 피해를 보여주는 부서진 표식과 사진을 든 성인이 같은 상대에게 새 보복 행위를 가하며 동일 문양이 두 사건을 잇는다
a retaliator carries a prior-harm token into a new attack against the identified responsible target and a repeated trace links both events
positive_fields.definition: Retaliatory violence requires a declared prior harm or debt, an adult retaliator who connects that earlier event to a specific adult target, a new violent reprisal, and a visible continuity token or mirrored consequence linking the two events. Anger, a single attack, competition, and abstract revenge styling are insufficient.

paraphrases: 전체 현장과 증거의 위치 관계를 먼저 기록한 뒤 동일 번호표를 중경과 눈금 포함 근접 촬영에서 이어 간다
linked overall midrange and scale-bearing close-up records preserve one item's identifier and location before collection
positive_fields.definition: Forensic scene documentation is a preservation process, not yellow-tape styling: an undisturbed scene is recorded through linked overall, midrange, and close-up views, stable evidence identifiers and measurement scales, and a location or sequence log that preserves where each item was found. A detective portrait or scattered markers without spatial continuity is insufficient.

paraphrases: 허구 현장의 벽과 바닥에 걸친 전체 혈흔 경계를 먼저 보존하고 방향 표식·눈금·번호가 같은 근접 기록으로 이어진다
an overall declared fictional stain field, substrate boundary, orientation marker, and scale-bearing close-up are recorded before causal interpretation
positive_fields.definition: Bloodstain observation documentation records a declared fictional or controlled stain field before interpretation: the substrate and full pattern boundary, stain distribution and orientation, scale-bearing close-ups, and a location record remain visible. Color alone does not prove blood, and a still pattern does not by itself establish weapon, assailant, sequence, or cause.

paraphrases: 허구의 구금실에서 공적 통제자가 특정 성인 수감자를 움직이지 못하게 통제하고 정보 요구와 연동된 의도적 고통을 가한다
a declared fictional official controller holds one adult detainee in custody while intentional severe suffering is tied to a visible interrogation or punishment demand
positive_fields.definition: A custodial-torture scene requires a declared fictional adult detainee under the physical control of an official or officially acquiesced controller, intentional infliction of severe physical or mental suffering, and a stated purpose such as obtaining information, punishment, intimidation, coercion, or discrimination. Restraint, questioning, injury, or cruelty without all relations is not enough; pixels cannot independently prove official authority or legal classification.

paraphrases: 허구의 보호 집단이 사용자 서사에서 명시되고 동일 작전 표식의 여러 부대가 집단 구성원과 생존 기반을 반복 표적화한다
a fictional protected group is explicitly declared while repeated units, records, and coordinated attacks show a campaign aimed at destroying that group in part
positive_fields.definition: A genocide profile applies only when the authorial core explicitly declares intent to destroy, in whole or in part, a protected group and one or more qualifying acts against members of that group. The visual scene must show a coordinated campaign, repeated group-targeting evidence, and a group-destruction consequence; pixels alone cannot prove special intent or infer real nationality, ethnicity, race, or religion from appearance.

paraphrases: 허구의 무력충돌 중 명확히 표시된 의료 구호소를 식별한 전투원이 그 보호 시설에 의도적으로 공격을 가하고 같은 지점에 결과가 남는다
in a declared fictional armed conflict, a clearly identified protected medical site or detained person is intentionally subjected to a prohibited act with same-target consequence
positive_fields.definition: A war-crime profile requires an explicitly declared armed-conflict nexus, a person or object whose protected status is supplied by the authorial core and visible context, a prohibited act directed at that protected target, and a localized consequence. Combat imagery, destruction, uniforms, or civilian presence alone cannot establish the legal classification.

paraphrases: 완전히 제압된 특정 성인 포로가 지정 위치에 놓이고 집행자의 명령 신호와 동시 동작이 그 포로에게만 향한다
a controlled adult captive occupies a fixed execution position while an authority signal triggers a synchronized lethal action directed only at that captive
positive_fields.definition: An execution scene shows a specific adult captive already under complete control, one or more executioners arranged in an ordered killing procedure, a command or synchronized action, and an immediate consequence on that captive without reciprocal combat. The scene alone does not determine whether the execution is lawful, unlawful, judicial, summary, or extrajudicial unless the authorial core states it.

paraphrases: 허구의 두 성인 장면에서 대상이 접촉을 명확히 거부하고 물러나려 하지만 행위자가 퇴로와 손목을 통제하며 원치 않는 성적 접촉을 지속한다
a declared fictional adult target withdraws and rejects unwanted sexual contact while the actor blocks exit and uses coercive control to continue the attempt
positive_fields.definition: An adult sexual-violence scene requires the authorial core to declare an unwanted sexual act, attempt, contact, or sexualized communication involving a specific adult target, lack of valid consent or consent produced by force, intimidation, fraud, coercion, threat, deception, incapacitation, abuse of power, or vulnerability, and a visible actor-to-target control relation. Clothing, affect, location, or intimacy alone never establishes consent or its absence.
