paraphrases: 사용자 서사에서 미성년자로 명시된 피해자에게 성인 가해자가 구체적 범죄 행위를 가하고 보호자의 개입 흔적이 같은 사건을 잇는다
a requester-declared minor is specifically targeted by an adult offender's named crime and a same-event escape protection or consequence trace remains visible
positive_fields.definition: A requester-declared minor is the specific target of a named criminal act. The scene shows one offender-to-target relation, a concrete act or coercive mechanism, and an immediate consequence or intervention trace belonging to that same event.

paraphrases: 성인 피해자가 허위 취업 문서로 모집되어 이동 중 통제되고 여권 압수와 채무 기록이 강제노동 장소의 착취 목적을 잇는다
an adult victim is recruited by deception, controlled during transfer, deprived of documents, and delivered into a visibly exploitative labor arrangement
positive_fields.definition: Adult trafficking in persons requires an adult victim, an action such as recruitment, transportation, transfer, harboring, or receipt, a means such as force, threat, coercion, abduction, fraud, deception, abuse of power or vulnerability, and a linked purpose of exploitation. Movement alone, smuggling, voluntary work, kidnapping without exploitation, and exploitative labor without the trafficking chain are distinct.

paraphrases: 허구의 공공 교통 허브에서 민간인을 겨냥한 폭력 위협이 외부 방송 요구와 연결되어 정부의 특정 행동을 강요하려는 목적을 드러낸다
a declared fictional threat against civilians at a public hub is linked through a broadcast demand to population intimidation or government compulsion
positive_fields.definition: A terrorism scene requires a declared violent act or threat intended to cause death or serious bodily injury to civilians or noncombatants, a public or population-facing target, and an explicit purpose to intimidate a population or compel a government or international organization. Destruction, ideology, armed actors, protest, or combat alone does not establish terrorism, and pixels cannot independently prove political purpose.

paraphrases: 압력 용기의 물리 기준선 가까이 막이 불룩해지고 국소 응력이 보이지만 안전 여유와 봉쇄가 아직 남아 있는 전이 직전
an intact load-bearing system with a rising driver, owned threshold datum, localized precursor strain, and a visibly remaining margin before failure
positive_fields.definition: A bounded system remains intact while a readable pressure, heat, tension, charge, or load accumulates toward a system-owned threshold reference. A localized precursor and a still-visible remaining margin must coexist before the transition; suspense, a gauge alone, a peak, an aura, or post-rupture aftermath is insufficient.

paraphrases: 두께가 있는 장벽의 한 접촉점에 힘이 집중되어 균열이 번지고 새 구멍을 통해 동일 주체가 통과하며 잔해가 같은 점에서 밀려나는 순간
one continuous force vector joins resistant barrier, contact rupture, fresh aperture, passage, and localized displaced material
positive_fields.definition: One aligned subject or force meets a previously resisting finite-thickness barrier, initiates rupture at a localized contact point, opens a new aperture, and crosses the former boundary with displaced material or another consequence at that same point. A barrierless explosion, preexisting opening, beam through fog, rubble-only aftermath, or victory pose is insufficient.

paraphrases: 기계식 조속기와 클램프가 engaged 위치에서 풀리며 같은 장치 안에 갇혀 있던 압력과 움직임이 한 경로로 방출되는 순간
one continuous source, functional restraint, disengagement action, same-source output path, and localized release consequence
positive_fields.definition: The same subject or system contains a functional limiter that visibly blocks motion, pressure, flow, or output. An active disengagement opens that limiter, and previously contained output emerges from the same source with an old-bound comparison and localized consequence. Waking, glow alone, an ordinary lock, costume change, possession, or external power donation is insufficient.

paraphrases: 정격 표식과 현재 부하가 같은 전기 패널에 보이고 한 단자에서 시작한 열 변색과 절연 손상이 버스 경로를 따라 퍼져 차단기가 동작하는 과정
a rated system under sustained excess input with a localized failure origin, dependency propagation, and protective trip or functional loss
positive_fields.definition: A technical system with a readable normal rating receives sustained excess load, develops a localized heat, insulation, deformation, or strain failure at one owned component, and propagates that failure through connected dependencies toward a protection response or functional loss. A short circuit alone, external explosion, isolated spark, single broken part, or post-collapse aftermath is insufficient.

labels: visible phase transition by nucleation and growth
paraphrases: 투명 관찰 용기 안의 한 시료에서 기존 상 속에 복수의 새 결정 핵이 생기고 온도 구배 방향으로 계면이 성장하며 두 상이 동시에 남아 있는 장면
one bounded specimen under a readable driver with parent phase, multiple nuclei, a propagating interface, and simultaneous phase coexistence
positive_fields.definition: One bounded material specimen remains continuous while a readable temperature, pressure, field, or concentration gradient drives multiple new-phase nuclei and a growing interface through the parent phase. Both phases must coexist in the same material system; lighting gradients, smoke, aura, unrelated materials, a completed product, or fantasy costume transformation is insufficient.

paraphrases: 같은 인물이 경계를 막 통과한 뒤 뒤의 다리가 붕괴해 귀환 경로가 사라지고 앞쪽의 새로운 조건이 이미 시작되는 장면
one continuous subject intersecting a one-way threshold as the route behind becomes unavailable and a downstream committed state begins
positive_fields.definition: The same subject or process crosses a defined one-way threshold while its return route visibly closes, collapses, floods, burns, severs, or is consumed, and a committed downstream consequence begins beyond it. An ordinary doorway, reversible portal, sign alone, subject merely beyond a line, or black-hole icon is insufficient.

labels: 접근 불가 대상에 대한 막힌 접근 장면
paraphrases: 닫히는 투명 게이트 너머의 한 대상을 향해 같은 성인이 손과 몸을 뻗지만 접촉하지 못하고 손끝과 경계 사이 간극이 남는 순간
one identifiable target beyond a closing boundary, the same adult's incomplete target-directed reach, continued separation, and a visible failed-contact gap
positive_fields.definition: One adult makes an incomplete approach toward one identifiable target while a physical or procedural barrier or unbridgeable distance keeps the target inaccessible. The adult, target, barrier, directed action, and immediate contact or entry gap must coexist; a sad expression, window portrait, targetless waiting, distant-view appreciation, nostalgia, grief, or generic separation is insufficient.

labels: immediate reward and long-term goal conflict event
즉시 보상과 장기 목표의 가시적 갈등 장면
paraphrases: 진행 중인 목표 도구 옆의 즉시 보상에 손을 뻗다 멈추고, 같은 성인의 선택 때문에 보상이 그대로 남거나 진척이 중단된 순간
one adult connecting a ready reward, active long-term goal, mutually exclusive hand action, and a same-frame resistance or enactment consequence
positive_fields.definition: The same adult faces one concrete immediate reward that conflicts with a marked longer-term goal, makes one visible resistance or enactment choice, and leaves an immediate outcome on the untouched reward or interrupted goal path. A menu choice, ordinary comparison, reward close-up, seductive pose, or hesitation without a goal marker is insufficient.

labels: same-category reacquisition beside unused prior items
사용하지 않은 중복품 추가 획득 사건
paraphrases: 개인 보관 공간의 미개봉 동일 제품 여러 개 앞에서 같은 성인이 같은 계열의 새 물건을 수령하고 보관 압박이 이어지는 순간
one adult linking multiple sealed matching prior items to a new same-category receipt with visible nonuse and storage pressure
positive_fields.definition: The same adult acquires another item from one category while several prior matching acquisitions remain visibly sealed or unused and already press on personal storage or attention. This is an observable acquisition event, not a diagnosis of addiction, obsession, compulsion, greed, or personality; retail inventory, warehouse work, emergency preparation, shared bulk purchase, or an actively used collection is insufficient.

labels: 가득 찬 용량에 추가 투입하는 사건
paraphrases: 이미 선반 경계까지 채워진 동일 물건 위로 같은 성인이 한 개를 더 넣자 물건이 떨어지고 통로가 막히는 순간
one bounded capacity already full before the adult's additional matching input, with the adding action and physical displacement joined in one causal line
positive_fields.definition: An adult continues adding matching resources after one visible storage or use capacity is already full, causing physical overflow, displacement, blockage, or the loss of space for another needed item in the same frame. Normal restocking, moving, archive work, abundance still life, or emergency preparation is insufficient.

labels: visible claim toward another adult's owned object
overt claim at an owner-held object event
다른 성인 소유물에 대한 가시적 청구 장면
소유자가 든 물건을 향한 공개적 청구 사건
paraphrases: 한 성인이 착용 중인 물건을 다른 성인이 공개적으로 요구하며 손을 뻗고, 현재 소유자가 물건을 몸 쪽으로 당겨 경계를 보이는 순간
one owner-held object between two adults, an overt claim or bid, the owner's protective response, and an unbroken owner-object relation
positive_fields.definition: One adult makes an overt claim, exchange bid, or boundary-crossing reach toward one primary object still visibly held or worn by another adult, and the current owner responds by protecting, refusing, considering, or withholding it. Gaze alone, gift exchange, ordinary purchase, shared use, owner admiration, or an automatic theft claim is insufficient.

labels: taking beyond one's marked share event
표시된 몫을 넘는 추가 취득 장면
타인의 지정 몫을 가져가는 분배 사건
paraphrases: 수령자별로 같은 몫이 놓인 분배대에서 한 성인이 자기 선을 넘어 옆 사람 몫 하나를 가져가고 그 자리에 빈칸이 남는 순간
one allocation rule, distinct recipient shares, a boundary-crossing hand, an extra share moving, and an immediate gap in another recipient's area
positive_fields.definition: Inside one marked allocation system, an adult crosses the boundary of their own share and moves one extra assigned share away from another recipient, leaving an immediate same-frame shortage. Agreed redistribution, donation, allocator error, multi-share delivery work, or a large share without a visible taking action is insufficient.

labels: visible public recognition bid with audience response
public presentation causing audience recognition event
청중 반응이 보이는 공개 인정 요청 장면
결과물 공개와 다중 청중 인정 사건
paraphrases: 성인이 완성한 비문자 결과물을 공개하자 서로 다른 청중이 렌즈와 몸을 동시에 돌리고 길을 열어 즉시 주목이 형성되는 순간
one adult presenter, one concrete marker, a public presentation action, several independent audience responses, and an immediate recognition consequence
positive_fields.definition: An adult publicly presents one specific work, achievement, or role marker to an identifiable audience whose several independent attention or access responses produce an immediate recognition result. This is an observable recognition bid, not proof of vanity, enduring status, fame, or actual rank; an incidental crowd, unrelated press, luxury object alone, or status pose is insufficient.

labels: 완료 뒤 다음 이정표를 추구하는 가시적 장면
이전 완료와 다음 목표가 연결된 성취 추구 사건
paraphrases: 완료 표시가 있는 이전 결과 옆에서 같은 성인이 다음 목표용 작업을 수행하고 진척 표지가 움직이며 도구와 시간이 실제로 투입되는 장면
one completed milestone, one distinct next target, current feedback, same-adult next-step work, and visible resource commitment on a single progression axis
positive_fields.definition: After one visible completed milestone, the same adult actively invests effort or resources toward one distinct next milestone while current progress feedback connects the completed and future states. This is a goal-pursuit event, not proof of ambition as a personality trait; celebration, routine work, determined expression, or a text-only plan is insufficient.

labels: resource access control claim changing another person's access
다른 사람의 접근을 바꾸는 자원 통제 청구 사건
paraphrases: 기존 통제자에게서 특정 자원 게이트의 권한 토큰을 넘겨받은 성인이 배분 경로를 바꾸자 다른 성인의 접근선이 즉시 허용 또는 차단되는 장면
one valued resource, an existing control system, a visible claim or transfer, an affected adult, and an immediate changed access path
positive_fields.definition: An adult visibly seeks or obtains control over one valued resource or access right, and the resulting grant, withholding, blockage, or rerouting changes an identifiable affected person's practical access. This is a bounded resource-control event, not proof of enduring power, domination, occupation, or rank; routine security work, collaborative handoff, throne pose, uniform, height, or camera angle is insufficient.

labels: visible local legend transmission at its site
paraphrases: 현재의 바위 흔적 앞에서 지역 화자가 그 표면을 가리키고 청자가 같은 흔적을 확인하며 기록한다
at the named site one teller points from a fixed trace to listeners who follow and record the account
positive_fields.definition: At one identifiable present-day site, a teller actively links one specific surviving trace or evidence object to attentive listeners through a readable gesture and shared line of attention. A storyteller portrait, tour group, atmospheric ruin, unrelated lecture, or book reading without the site-evidence-listener relation is insufficient.

labels: legendary rock trace as site evidence
paraphrases: 지면에 박힌 특이 바위의 손가락 홈을 성인 손과 도구로 함께 재어 비범한 크기와 표면 연속성을 보인다
a fixed boulder carries a five-finger grip trace whose scale and surface continuity are read beside a witness hand
positive_fields.definition: One distinctive rock or outcrop remains fixed to a precise site and carries an anomalous imprint, body hollow, grip groove, hoof mark, or cleft that is continuous with the rock surface. A human, tool, or body-scale comparison makes the trace legible and separates it from ordinary weathering, painted symbols, loose props, and generic monoliths.

paraphrases: 거인의 발이 평지에 닿은 자리에서 신선한 골이 끊기지 않고 계곡으로 벌어진다
a dragon's body drags through ordinary ground and the continuous furrow becomes a river course behind the contact
positive_fields.definition: An extraordinary agent directly contacts ordinary terrain and one continuous displacement path becomes a new landform consequence in the same frame. The baseline terrain, contact action, fresh deformation, and formed result must remain causally joined; a hero posing in scenery, a finished valley, detached blast, map, or aura does not prove origin causality.

labels: guarded hidden treasure attempt visibly failing
수호자가 보물 회수를 막는 실패 장면
paraphrases: 성인 탐색자가 고분 바닥의 반쯤 드러난 상자를 들어 올리려는 순간 수호자가 접근선을 막아 상자가 원위치에 남는다
an adult seeker's tool reaches a fixed hoard niche while the guardian blocks the exact line and the cache remains embedded
positive_fields.definition: A clearly adult seeker is caught in an active digging, opening, reaching, or lifting attempt toward one fixed hidden cache while an identifiable guardian interrupts that same access path. The transfer visibly fails and the cache remains attached to its site. An open-chest portrait, guard merely standing nearby, successful handoff, aftermath, or unrelated fight is insufficient.

paraphrases: 퇴적층에 박힌 여러 기초와 벽·문지방·거리 경계가 연결되고 ROV가 크기를 기록한다
multiple submerged wall returns and thresholds remain joined to foundations along a street while a diver provides scale
positive_fields.definition: Several architectural elements remain joined to fixed foundations and street, courtyard, or room alignments in one submerged settlement plan. Water, sediment, aquatic occupation, and diver or ROV scale establish in-situ context. A single shipwreck, scattered artifacts, fantasy palace, loose rubble, or one wall does not prove a settlement.

labels: former vessel breaking into spectral continuity
ghost ship with former-vessel continuity breach
물질 선체와 유령성 단절이 공존하는 배
paraphrases: 닳은 도르래와 화물 결박이 남은 물질 선체의 일부가 같은 삭구 선을 따라 투명한 공백으로 끊기고 항적도 그 지점에서 어긋난다
one working ship keeps a solid bow and service-worn deck while the connected mid-hull becomes spectrally absent and its wake breaks under a witness view
positive_fields.definition: One identifiable former working vessel remains physically readable through hull, rigging, deck, and service residue while a bounded connected part of that same structure breaks into translucency, absence, or spectral displacement. A present witness, waterline, wake, or reflection makes the anomaly legible. A foggy abandoned ship, ordinary wreck, empty deck, fully translucent boat, or unrelated double exposure is insufficient.

paraphrases: 양쪽 바지통이 무릎 아래 종아리에서 각각 끝나고 밑단부터 발목까지 맨다리가 이어지는 카프리
two separately readable trouser hems stop at mid-calf while both ankles remain clearly exposed
a full-body frame proves garment length through knee, hem, ankle, and shoe landmarks rather than camera cropping
positive_fields.definition: A bifurcated trouser garment whose left and right hems both end below the knees around the calves while clearly exposed lower-leg intervals continue from those hems to the ankles and shoes. Fit, fabric, and decoration may vary. The paired below-knee hem landmarks and bare ankle gaps distinguish capri trousers from Bermuda shorts, full-length trousers, and ankle-adjacent seven-eighth crops.
concepts: knees hems ankles and shoes together
distinct from Bermuda and seven-eighth lengths

distinct from Bermuda and seven-eighth lengths

paraphrases: 허리에서 모인 많은 천이 엉덩이와 가랑이에 풍성한 여유를 만들고 좌우 발목 밴딩으로 각각 수렴하는 바지
roomy seat and thigh volume falls in loose folds before gathering tightly at both ankles
the waist, crotch depth, outer-leg volume, fold convergence, and two cuffs remain readable in one frame
positive_fields.definition: A long bifurcated trouser construction with one gathered or drawstring waist, pronounced fabric volume through the seat, crotch, hips, and thighs, multiple loose folds that travel down each leg, and two narrow gathered or elasticated ankle cuffs. A dropped rise may strengthen the form but is not universally required. The convergence into two ankle cuffs distinguishes this topology from straight wide trousers, smooth balloon or barrel legs, and ordinary joggers.
concepts: distinct from joggers and balloon trousers

concept_terms: distinct from joggers and balloon trousers

paraphrases: 좌우 바지 옆선이 각각 바깥으로 볼록하게 휘고 중간에서 가장 부풀었다가 매끈한 밑단으로 좁아짐
two separately readable convex trouser legs peak in volume at mid-leg before clean tapered hems
curved seam and fabric mass, not a wide lens or bent pose, own the balloon silhouette
positive_fields.definition: A bifurcated trouser silhouette in which each leg forms a deliberately convex outer contour, reaches its greatest fabric volume away from the body around the thigh or calf, and then narrows smoothly into a clean lower hem. The paired curved legs and smooth taper distinguish balloon trousers from straight wide legs, harem trousers gathered into ankle cuffs, joggers, and a balloon prop near ordinary pants.
concepts: distinct from harem cuffs and straight wide legs

concept_terms: distinct from harem cuffs and straight wide legs

paraphrases: 허리에서 시작한 두 스커트 판이 사선으로 실제 겹치고 옆 끈이나 단추가 그 겹침을 고정함
one front panel crosses over another while the lower panel continues behind the diagonal edge
the waist fastening and two fabric layers remain visible together rather than reading as a printed line
positive_fields.definition: A skirt closure made from two separately traceable fabric panels that begin at the waist, cross diagonally over the front or side, and remain held by one visible tie, button, snap, or buckle while an under-panel continues beneath the top edge. A printed diagonal, decorative sash, single slit, asymmetrical hem, or separate scarf cannot replace the functional panel overlap.
concepts: distinct from print slit or scarf

concept_terms: distinct from print slit or scarf

paraphrases: 매끈한 캐미솔 몸판의 네크라인이나 밑단에 실제 구멍과 꽃 모티프가 있는 좁은 레이스 띠가 봉제됨
a separate openwork lace band follows the neckline edge with a stitched join and scalloped free border
the lace-to-base material boundary remains sharp enough to distinguish trim from a printed motif
